control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during start-up after maintenance on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 14 November 2018 a potential incident was recorded on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
